scope: Local source fix and production-browser candidate validation; existing alpha.14 release artifacts are separate.
rootCause: Every box shadow was treated as potentially unbounded paint. A later-painted decorative shadow could block every earlier control and text box, even when its element was far below the viewport. Supported sRGB shadows now have conservative bounds for offset, blur and spread, with ancestor overflow clipping. Unsupported syntax/colors, transformed ancestry and fragmented geometry remain unbounded blockers.

baseline.method: Fresh disposable workspace, public page observation and screenshot through the normal MCP adapter.
